items.title: Resolve no-story gitCwd via the project-level resolver in verifier.ts
items.context: At verifier.ts:604 the no---story branch falls back to projectRoot. Change it to evaluateStoryDirConfigInsideGitRoot({metadataRoot:projectRoot}).gitRootAbs ?? projectRoot (already exported in core/story-signed-workspace-resolution.ts, id-independent, never throws). Covers the bare concept/channel/lint CLI gates on wrapper-root. cwd-only; do not change gate semantics or git command text; plain repos byte-identical.
items.userSees: User runs lattice validate --concept (no --story) in a wrapper-root project and the concept gate runs git diff in the resolved gitRoot instead of printing warning: Not a git repository / git diff failed.

happy.desc: bare validate --concept on a wrapper-root project resolves gitCwd to the gitRoot (no not a git repository)

edge.desc: plain repo / no configured gitRoot resolves the no-story gitCwd to projectRoot (byte-identical)

adversarial.desc: resolver returns null gitRoot or errors internally -> falls back to projectRoot, no crash

items.title: Test: bare CLI gate resolves gitRoot on wrapper-root; plain repo unchanged
items.context: Wrapper-root fixture (gitRoot != metadataRoot): the no-story gitCwd resolves to the gitRoot (no not a git repository); plain repo / no configured gitRoot resolves to projectRoot. Test at function level.
items.userSees: lattice validate GREEN with the new test asserting the no-story gitCwd resolves to the gitRoot on a wrapper-root fixture.
